get_dataloaders: create train and eval dataloaders for the MRPC GLUE dataset using a given model name and batch size
get_training_utilities: build a complete training setup with model, optimizer, dataloaders, and LR scheduler for MRPC classification
get_named_parameters: extract a dictionary of named parameters from a model wrapped in parallel training wrappers
evaluate_model: run a model evaluation loop over a dataloader and compute metrics with multi-process gathering support
refactor_get_training_utilities: refactor get_training_utilities to support a custom dataset or different optimizer configuration
